name: Generalized Tensorial Radiance Fields (GTensoRF)
definition: A framework that learns multiple scenes simultaneously using higher-order tensor decomposition, shifting from scene-specific to generalizable radiance fields to reduce training time and enable multi-scene editing.
summary: Generalized Tensorial Radiance Fields is a multi-scene optimization framework using higher-order tensor decomposition to enable parallel training and view-consistent 3D editing across multiple environments.
